page: Microsoft Azure EC48es_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is built on an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor clocked at up to 4.2 GHz, featuring 48 dedicated virtual CPUs across 24 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation totals 384.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The hardware architecture incorporates 260 MB of L3 cache alongside support for advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 vector extensions and Intel AMX matrix instructions for accelerated integer and bfloat16 calculations.

Benchmark measurements indicate solid compute and data processing capabilities. The instance achieved strong top-quartile results across several Geekbench workloads, registering 2039.0 in single-core tests, 17683.0 in multi-core metrics, and 42968.0 in Clang code compilation. In PassMark testing, the server attained an overall CPU mark of 61407.54, accompanied by strong scores in encryption tests (48787.8) and database operations (24975.7). In contrast, general memory subsystem benchmarks and stress-ng CPU processing landed in the median performance tier, while Redis throughput reached 53.23 million operations per second.

The EC48es_v6 provides no bundled local ephemeral storage, relying instead on remote network-attached Premium Storage for persistent file systems and databases. Compute-intensive vector operations benefit from native hardware extensions, but workloads that demand high local disk throughput or sub-millisecond local scratch disks must factor in remote storage latencies. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs, leaving parallel graphics or accelerator-specific AI training to other specialized families.

Given its high memory footprint, extensive L3 cache, and strong database operation metrics, the instance fits enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale caching tiers, software compilation farms, and medium-to-large business applications that demand dedicated CPU threads without local disk dependencies.
description: Microsoft Azure EC48es_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine delivering 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory on an x86_64 Intel Xeon platform clocked at 4.2 GHz. Supported by 24 physical cores with multithreading and a 260 MB L3 cache, the system includes native extensions for AVX-512, AMX, and accelerated cryptographic operations. Benchmark results place the instance in the top 25% for Geekbench compute, software compilation, and PassMark database operations, while synthetic stress tests and Redis performance remain within median bands. Because the server features no bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, it relies on network-attached Premium Storage for all persistent disk workloads. The EC48es_v6 is engineered for large enterprise workloads requiring high memory density and dedicated compute resources, including in-memory relational databases, real-time analytics engines, and intensive multi-threaded compilation pipelines.
